def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    t0[1:, :] = t0[:-1, :].clone()
    t1.mul_(2)
    t1[1:, :] = t1[:-1, :].clone()
    v1 = t2.unfold(0, 12, 20)
    v2 = t2.view(torch.int32)
    v3 = v1.select(1, 8)
    v1.add_(v1.flip(0))
    v2.masked_fill_(v2 > -2, k)
    return (v3, t0, v3, v3, t0, lst, dct)
